analogy.rationale: Tachykinin receptors (TACR1/2/3) are G protein-coupled receptors that are poorly expressed in most of these cell lines, so tachykinin antagonists should elicit little transcriptional response; other GPCR antagonist classes, especially neuropeptide receptor antagonists, are expected to behave similarly with minimal or no response.
